_comment: Curated, publicly traded 13F institutional filers. Every CIK is resolved live at run time - never a hand-typed CIK - so a wrong or delisted ticker degrades to 'no data for this manager' rather than silently reading a different filer's holdings under this name. Necessarily partial: large, influential 13F filers that are privately held (Renaissance Technologies, Citadel Advisors, Bridgewater, ...) have no ticker and are not reachable this way. Expand by adding tickers and names, not CIKs.
_filer_comment: The ticker resolves to the CIK of the *listed operating company*, and for an asset manager that is usually the entity that files the 10-K, not the one that files the 13F - those are separate registrants (T. Rowe Price Group vs. its adviser subsidiaries). build_institutional_screen.resolve_filer_ciks therefore tries the ticker's CIK first and then searches EDGAR by company name, keeping only entities whose EDGAR conformed name token-matches 'name' (or an alias) AND that actually file 13F-HRs. EDGAR's company search is a prefix match, so an adviser filed under a reordered name is unreachable from the colloquial spelling: give those managers a 'filer_aliases' list of name prefixes to search as well (for example "PRICE T ROWE"). Aliases are names, still verified against EDGAR - not CIKs, which is what keeps a typo from reading another manager's holdings under this label. The published screen's 'manager_coverage' reports, per manager, which CIKs resolved and why any resolved to none; that is the place to look before adding an alias.
_style_comment: 'style' matters because it is not a random subset of institutional flow. The largest managers here (BlackRock, State Street, Invesco) run AUM dominated by index funds and ETFs - their quarter-over-quarter position changes are close to mechanically determined by index membership and fund flows, not conviction, and feeding that into a research score that already carries valuation and sector-percentile inputs would partly reintroduce market-cap/size as a hidden second input under a 'smart money' label. build_institutional_screen.py defaults to style=active only for exactly this reason. 'alternative' (private-equity/alternative-asset managers) is excluded from the default sleeve too: their public-equity 13F stakes are typically residual holdings from take-privates or specific strategic positions, lumpy and idiosyncratic rather than a portfolio-flow signal comparable to a mutual-fund manager's.

managers.name: T. Rowe Price
managers._note: The ticker's own CIK ('PRICE T ROWE GROUP INC') is the listed holding company and files no 13F-HR. Its investment-management subsidiary was spun out in March 2022 as its own SEC-registered adviser, 'T. Rowe Price Investment Management, Inc.', CIK 0001897612 - secondary-source-verified (indexed EDGAR filing URLs, not a direct live query from this environment), not yet confirmed against this pipeline's own manager_coverage. The legacy CIK 0000080255 ('PRICE T ROWE ASSOCIATES INC /MD/') may still be separately active too - don't assume it's superseded until manager_coverage shows both.

managers.name: Affiliated Managers Group
managers._note: Confirmed (secondary-source) multi-affiliate structure: the parent's own CIK 0001004434 files 13F-NT (a notice that it does not exercise investment discretion), not 13F-HR. Its equity affiliates file independently under their own names - e.g. Pzena Investment Management LLC (CIK 0001027796) and AQR Capital Management LLC (CIK 0001167557) both currently file 13F-HR. Neither has a public ticker of its own, which this config's ticker-anchored identity model requires (see the file's own top-level _comment on why untickered managers are deliberately excluded) - reaching them would need a schema change, not just an alias.

managers.name: Janus Henderson
managers._note: manager_coverage showed CIK 0001274173 ('Janus Henderson Group PLC', secondary-source confirmed as the correct, actively-filing 13F-HR entity) being rejected with an empty conformed name from EDGAR's own search feed - not a wrong alias. build_institutional_screen.resolve_filer_ciks now only rejects a search hit at that stage when EDGAR actually supplied a non-matching name, deferring an empty one to the submissions-backed check that reads the real name - this should let JHG resolve on the next run without any alias change. The ticker itself still doesn't resolve to a CIK via SEC's company_tickers.json (unconfirmed why - JHG is UK-domiciled and dual-listed), so this depends entirely on the alias search.

managers.name: Virtus Investment Partners
managers._note: Multi-affiliate structure, same limitation as AMG: the parent's own CIK files no 13F-HR, and its affiliates - e.g. Kayne Anderson Rudnick Investment Management LLC (CIK 0001021223) and Duff & Phelps Investment Management Co (CIK 0000765443), both secondary-source confirmed as currently filing 13F-HR - have no public ticker of their own. Every 'rejected ... (None): name does not match' note this manager produced was an empty-conformed-name search hit, the same resolve_filer_ciks fix described on the JHG entry - worth checking manager_coverage again after the next run in case one of Virtus's own existing search candidates resolves now, independent of the affiliate-name question.

managers.name: Artisan Partners
managers._note: The CIK this resolved to (0001010643) stopped filing after 2011. Secondary-source research points to 'Artisan Partners Limited Partnership', CIK 0001466153, as the current, actively-filing operating entity (341 holdings, $66.8B as of the most recent quarter found) - not yet confirmed against this pipeline's own manager_coverage. Its name should already be reachable by the existing 'Artisan Partners' search (a CIK 0001466153 conformed name starting with those two words is a prefix match), so if it still doesn't appear after the next run, the gap is in resolve_filer_ciks's candidate handling, not this alias list.

managers.name: AllianceBernstein
managers._note: The ticker's own CIK ('ALLIANCEBERNSTEIN HOLDING L.P.') is the publicly traded holding LP and files no 13F-HR. Secondary-source research identifies the operating LP that actually files as 'AllianceBernstein L.P.', CIK 0001109448 - not yet confirmed against this pipeline's own manager_coverage, and its exact EDGAR conformed-name spelling (with or without a space) is unconfirmed, which is why both a spaced and unspaced alias are listed alongside the pre-2000 legal name as a third fallback.
